assets/advanced/topic_1_01.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An official restriction requiring</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">people to remain indoors during</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">specified hours.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Legal constraints</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_02.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A court order requiring a particular</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">action or prohibiting specified</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">conduct.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Legal constraints</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_03.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The legal authority of a court or</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">public body over a place, person or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">type of case.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Legal constraints</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_04.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An earlier decision or event used as</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">a reference for deciding a</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">comparable later case.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Legal constraints</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_05.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Protection granted by a state to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">someone seeking refuge from</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">persecution abroad.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Rights and remedies</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_06.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The return of property or money, or</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">restoration of what was wrongfully</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">taken.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Rights and remedies</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_07.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A remedy or compensation intended to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">put right a loss, injustice or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">grievance.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Rights and remedies</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_08.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A complaint about treatment</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">considered unfair, especially within</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">an organisation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Rights and remedies</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_09.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The use of force or threats to make</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">someone act against their free</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">choice.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Power and exclusion</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_10.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The expression of disagreement with</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">a prevailing opinion, policy or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">authority.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Power and exclusion</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_11.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The deprivation of a person's right</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">to vote or effective access to</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">voting.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Power and exclusion</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_12.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A mark of social disapproval</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">attached to a characteristic,</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">condition or experience.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Power and exclusion</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_13.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An obligation to explain decisions,</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">answer for their consequences and</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">face appropriate scrutiny.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Public standards</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_14.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The act or state of meeting</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">applicable rules, requirements or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">standards.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Public standards</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_15.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The act of making previously</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">private, confidential or unknown</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">information available.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Public standards</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_16.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The organised process of obtaining</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">goods or services, particularly</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">through purchasing or contracting.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Public standards</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_17.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The possibility of more than one</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">reasonable meaning or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">interpretation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Interpretation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_18.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A qualification or warning that</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">limits how a statement or conclusion</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">should be understood.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Interpretation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_19.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A difference between records, claims</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">or results that would normally be</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">expected to agree.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Interpretation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_20.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A systematic tendency to favour a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">particular perspective or outcome</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">rather than assess impartially.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Interpretation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_21.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Something yielded or accepted to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">reduce disagreement or help secure</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">an agreement.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Negotiation and judgement</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_22.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A point at which progress is blocked</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">because the parties cannot reach</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">agreement.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Negotiation and judgement</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_23.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Broad agreement within a group,</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">which need not mean identical views</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">on every detail.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Negotiation and judgement</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_24.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The authority to choose how to act</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">within permitted limits using one's</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">own judgement.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Negotiation and judgement</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_25.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Something intended to discourage an</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">action by making its likely</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">consequences unattractive.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Consequences and restrictions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_26.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Consequences of an action,</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">especially indirect or unwelcome</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">effects that follow later.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Consequences and restrictions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_27.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A reduction in the extent, duration</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">or availability of something.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Consequences and restrictions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_28.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An omission or ambiguity that</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">permits avoidance of a rule's</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">intended effect.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Consequences and restrictions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_29.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A possible future event or</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">circumstance that may require an</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">alternative response.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Planning and evaluation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_30.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The extent to which a proposal can</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">realistically be carried out under</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">relevant constraints.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Planning and evaluation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_31.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Close, careful examination intended</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">to assess details, validity or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">conduct.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Planning and evaluation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_32.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Understanding of a past event made</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">possible by knowing what happened</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">afterwards.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Planning and evaluation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_33.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Most people must stay indoors after</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">a set time, with specified</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">exceptions.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Legal constraints</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_34.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A temporary court order blocks</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">demolition pending a hearing.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Legal constraints</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_35.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The tribunal lacks legal authority</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">to decide this type of dispute.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Legal constraints</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_36.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An earlier ruling guides later</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">decisions only where the</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">circumstances are comparable.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Legal constraints</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_37.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A person requests protection from</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">another state against persecution.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Rights and remedies</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_38.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The remedy restores property that</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">was taken from its owner.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Rights and remedies</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_39.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Affected people seek a remedy for</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">harm, which need not take one fixed</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">form.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Rights and remedies</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_40.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An employee formally complains about</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">unfair treatment after informal</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">discussions fail.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Rights and remedies</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_41.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Threats undermine the claim that a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">person agreed freely.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Power and exclusion</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_42.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An objection is formally recorded</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">rather than hidden behind apparent</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">unanimity.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Power and exclusion</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_43.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">People are deprived of voting</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">rights, rather than merely</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">encountering a minor inconvenience.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Power and exclusion</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_44.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A campaign challenges social</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">disapproval while recognising</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">differences between people.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Power and exclusion</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_45.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A director must still explain and</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">answer for a decision made through</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">delegated work.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Public standards</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_46.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Following the prescribed rules does</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">not by itself prove fairness.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Public standards</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_47.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Previously private financial</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">information is made available so a</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">conflict can be assessed.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Public standards</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_48.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Purchasing is organised through bids</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">and a recorded supplier-selection</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">process.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Public standards</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_49.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The wording reasonably supports more</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">than one interpretation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Interpretation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_50.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Support for a proposal is qualified</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">by an important forecasting</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">assumption.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Interpretation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_51.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Two records that should agree</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">contain conflicting information.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Interpretation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_52.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The way respondents were selected</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">systematically distorted the</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">survey's representation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Interpretation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_53.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">One side yields on a secondary point</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">while maintaining its principal</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">demand.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Negotiation and judgement</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_54.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Disagreement prevents negotiations</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">from moving forward.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Negotiation and judgement</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_55.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The group broadly agrees on its aim</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">despite remaining differences about</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">implementation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Negotiation and judgement</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_56.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Officials may exercise judgement</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">within the rules, but cannot simply</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">ignore them.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Negotiation and judgement</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_57.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An undesirable consequence</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">discourages people from taking a</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">prohibited action.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Consequences and restrictions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_58.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A decision produces later adverse</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">effects on people outside the</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">initial dispute.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Consequences and restrictions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_59.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An existing freedom or service is</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">reduced rather than necessarily</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">abolished.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Consequences and restrictions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_60.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A weakness in the wording previously</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">allowed people to bypass a rule's</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">purpose.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Consequences and restrictions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_61.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An alternative plan prepares for a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">particular possible adverse event.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Planning and evaluation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_62.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A study asks whether a proposal can</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">be carried out, rather than whether</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">it is profitable.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Planning and evaluation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_63.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Figures receive detailed examination</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">because their underlying assumptions</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">remain unclear.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Planning and evaluation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_1_64.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#416c84" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#416c84"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Knowing the eventual outcome makes</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">earlier evidence appear clearer than</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">it originally was.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#416c84">Planning and evaluation</text></svg>
